verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents on-site shredding of unwanted mail with destruction certificates available on request, and lets users choose per mail item whether to have it opened and scanned or shipped unopened. It does not document how long physical mail is stored; the 'unlimited cloud storage' refers to digital scans, not physical retention. Missing for 10: a documented physical-mail storage window or retention policy, explicit per-item shred-request workflow docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I control what happens to the physical mail — documented storage windows, on-request shredding with confirmation, and per-item disposal choices

citations.quote: All of your unwanted mail is shredded on-site using mobile shredding services... Document destruction certificates are available upon request.
